meta.name: seo-content-brief
meta.description: SEO content brief creation with keyword research, search intent analysis, and content structure. Covers SERP analysis, heading hierarchy, word count targets, and internal linking strategy. Use for: content briefs, SEO writing, blog strategy, content planning, keyword targeting. Triggers: seo content brief, content brief, seo brief, keyword research, search intent, content strategy, blog brief, seo writing, content planning, keyword targeting, serp analysis, content outline, seo article, blog seo

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成含关键词研究和搜索意图分析的SEO内容简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为博客或文章创建结构化的SEO内容简报
copy.tagline_en: Create SEO content briefs with keyword research and search intent analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured SEO content briefs for blog posts or articles

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据关键词进行 SERP 分析、搜索意图判断、内容结构规划，并生成包含标题层级、字数目标和内链策略的 SEO 内容简报。
howto.when: 当你提到“SEO 内容简报”、“关键词研究”、“搜索意图”或要求制定博客策略时触发。

say.text: 帮我为“小型团队项目管理工具”做一个 SEO 内容简报。
分析“最佳项目管理软件”的搜索意图和排名靠前的内容。
say.note: Claude 会判断意图类型并提取竞争对手数据。

say.text: 为“项目管理工具对比”制定标题层级和字数目标。
say.note: Claude 会输出 H1-H3 结构和推荐字数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can perform SERP analysis, search intent assessment, and content structure planning based on a keyword, then generate an SEO content brief with heading hierarchy, word count targets, and internal linking strategy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'SEO content brief', 'keyword research', 'search intent', or ask for blog strategy.

say_en.text: Create an SEO content brief for 'best project management tools for small teams'.
say_en.note: Claude will research keywords and SERP, then output a full brief.

say_en.text: Analyze search intent and top-ranking content for 'best project management software'.
say_en.note: Claude will identify intent type and extract competitor data.

say_en.text: Outline heading hierarchy and word count for 'project management tools comparison'.
say_en.note: Claude will provide H1-H3 structure and recommended word count.
